SELECT ${lineChartGrouping} AS item,
${cnt_all_var} AS count,
$__timeInterval(${timestamp}) AS time
FROM  ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(${timestamp})
  AND $__adHocFilter() 
GROUP BY time, item
ORDER BY time ASC, count DESC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Requests Over Time per Hostname - Summary; du=${__user.login}'

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  ${item_formatted_for_display} as item,
  ${item_formatted_for_filter} as filter_item,
  ${cnt_all_var} AS count,
  ${errorRate_var} AS errorRate, /*HTTP STATUS CODE ERRORS*/
  ${percentError_var} AS percentError  /*NETWORK ERRORS */
FROM  ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(${timestamp})
  AND $__adHocFilter() 
  AND item NOT IN '~~~SAMPLED_OUT~~~'
GROUP BY item, filter_item
HAVING errorRate>=${minErrorRate}
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT ${treemapCells}
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Error Rate for top; du=${__user.login}'

options.content:
Using Error Analysis Dashboard

Usage Overview

The Error Analysis dashboard helps users quickly find and remediate errors:
  • The top two Summary panels provide an overview timeline of the data. You can use the 'lineChartGrouping' variable to decide how you'd like to see the data grouped. Then drag a rectangle around a time period of interest to 'zoom in' to that time period.
  • After you've 'zoomed in', expand the other 'rows' in the dashboard to explore the data.
  • To view raw data, click on a panel in the treemap to see a 'View Raw Logs' menu option. Note, this will open in a new window.
  • Alternatively, you can select the 'Filter to this item' menu option, which will add that variable value to the control filters at the top of the page.

Controls

  1. The 'Focus on' selection allows you to select the primary data attribute you want to group your data around and focus on for your investigation or research.
  2. The 'Customize 'Drilldown Path' order' allows you to modify the default order of data attributes used when drilling into the data in the panels below. You can see the 'Drilldown path' presented in the 'Error Treemaps' panel. Being able to adjust the default order allows for quicker investigation of incidents
  3. Use the 'Min Error Rate' filter to filter out items that have a low error rate. For example, enter .05 in the 'Min Error Rate' filter to only show items that have a 5% or higher error rate
  4. You can jump to any element in the 'Drilldown path' section of the 'Error Tree' panel
  5. You can click 'reset all variables' at any point to discard any changes you have made to the filters and start again.

All TrafficPeak VIDS

Video Description
TrafficPeak Error Analysis Video (here) (10 min) An overview on how to use the Error Analysis Dashboard to find errors that users are experiencing when requesting content.
Cache & URL Analysis Video (here) (14 min) An overview on how to use TrafficPeak to identify resources which are having low caching rates.
Creating and Customizing TrafficPeak Dashboards Video (here) (37 min) An overview on how to create and customize TrafficPeak Dashboards.
Sending DataStream data to TrafficPeak (here) (10 min) An overview on how to set Akamai DataStream and properties to send data to TrafficPeak.

list.definition:
WITH
    '${filter:raw}' AS flt,
    ${drill_chain} as drill_chain,
    arrayFilter(dim -> '${treeMapGroupBy}' != dim, drill_chain) as filtered,
    arrayConcat(['${treeMapGroupBy}'], filtered) as reordered,
    arrayFilter(dim -> position(flt, dim) = 0, reordered) AS remaining
SELECT 
if(
    (if(empty(remaining), '${treeMapGroupBy}', remaining[1])) = 'statusCode', 'toString(statusCode)',
    (if(empty(remaining), '${treeMapGroupBy}', remaining[1]))
  ) AS result
